query:
SELECT 
  id,
  slug,
  title,
  year,
  client,
  excerpt,
  designNotes,
  seoKeywords,
  tags
FROM projects 
WHERE discipline = 'scenic_design' 
AND status = 'published'
ORDER BY year DESC, title
LIMIT 25;
